A '''food pearl''' was a type of [[Pearl/Legends|pearl]] found in caverns below the surface of [[Sunshine Lake]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. The pearls were shiny, yellow spheres that littered the caves of an [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The species ate the pearls as their main [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] source. They sliced the pearls up with knives before consuming them.<ref name="E9">[[Ewoks (1985) 9|''Ewoks'' (1985) 9]]</ref> The growth of the pearls was fostered by means of a powerful [[red pearl]] and, after that pearl was destroyed in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], a [[blue pearl]].<ref name="E9" />
